title: A box or circle can be drawn out from its centre
goal: Holding Option while dragging a rectangle or ellipse grows it out from where the drag started, the way Photoshop does, so a circle can be centred on a point (the icon mock draws its crown out from 12, 8 and its shoulder out from a corner). Inside an icon frame the centre and the size both land on whole units.
notes: Found by icon-snapping-reaches-what-the-icon-mock-draws (2026-10-15). AnnotationDrag.end(constrained:shape:) in Sources/PhotonzCore/Tools.swift only does corner-to-corner; nothing reads Option for shapes. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-draw-wt.html steps 5 and 6 ("An ellipse snaps by its center and its diameter"). Snapping is already in place: CanvasNSView.snappedAnnotationPoint routes icon-frame drags through IconSnap, so a centred drag needs the anchor kept as the centre and the far corner mirrored. Check Option is free for shape drags (UX-PATTERNS §7).
acceptance: Option-dragging a rectangle or ellipse grows it out from the press point on every side, live while dragging
Shift with Option keeps it square or circular around that centre
Inside an icon frame the centre and the diameter land on whole units, as in steps 5 and 6 of the Draw an icon on the grid mock
A walk at Next defaults draws a circle out from a box corner and claims its centre in the exported SVG

log.note: Adversarial before: Option was free for shape drags (only Select, marquee, fill and handles read it), Photoshop and Illustrator users expect Option-from-centre; mock steps 5/6 name the shape by centre and diameter in the pill, so the pill now says center 12, 8 · d 8 during a centred drag. After: preview, pill and commit agree; Option toggles live mid-drag via flagsChanged. Looked at all four walk pictures: crown and shoulder grow from their presses, square stays square, pill legible white on accent.
left rough (no task, under the bar): Option does not centre the Frame, Lens or Zoom Callout box drags; Option on Line/Arrow ignored by design. Both in the audit rough list.

Option-drag grows Rectangle/Ellipse/Highlight out from the press (Shift+Option square/circle), live in preview and mid-drag key changes; in icon frames centre and size land on whole units and the pill reads center 12, 8 · d 8 like mock step 5. Core: AnnotationDrag.endpoints, IconSnap.readout(centre:corner:shape:), TDD. Verified: full suite 13266 green, new walk shapes-drawn-out-from-the-centre-walk at Next defaults (SVG holds crown at 8,4 r4, shoulder centred on the box corner at 6,7 r3, square 2,15 6x6), shapes-snap-in-an-icon and copy-an-icon-as-svg walks green. Commit d72608c4.
